title: 形状为生日气球文字
prompt: Create a hyper-realistic 3D rendering of balloon letters forming the word [WOW]. Each letter should look like a shiny, inflatable mylar balloon with a bold printed pattern. Use a mix of textures such as [checkered print, color grids, polka dots, or glossy metallic black]. The balloons should be semi-reflective with realistic air volume, seams, wrinkles, and pressure points. Give each letter a distinct, playful surface design but keep the overall look cohesive. Use a soft pastel background, like [Orange color], to contrast the balloon textures. Lighting should create crisp reflections and soft shadows. The rendering must be photorealistic, fun, and vibrant — like a high-end visual for a creative pop-art birthday installation or fashion campaign.
description: 使用Nano Banana Pro或Nano Banana Pro模型，轻松打造超逼真3D生日气球文字，以闪亮金属质感与活泼图案为时尚摄影注入创意视觉，呈现半反射纹理与真实褶皱细节的惊艳效果。
